arqua.desc: Primordial tyrant of the ocean, at least in a different region. Questionably skilled at beastieball.
arqua.name: Arqua

bandit.desc: A thieving Familiar that lives in caves. They join Beastieball games in hopes of stealing the ball.
bandit.name: Bandit

bibi.desc: Bibi is a little white bird, OK?

mod_data.author: Robin nightmarejudge
mod_data.description: Bibi is a little white bird from hollow_tones on Twitch
mod_data.name: Bibi

bibi.name: Bibi

bugstie.desc: An lonely and anxious beastie-ish creature they want to play ball but feel like something is missing to reach their full potential
bugstie.name: Bugstie

cobby.desc: Playing Beastieball sometimes causes this Familiar's kernels to pop. They quickly regrow, so Beasties enjoy the mid-game snack without worry.
cobby.name: Cobby

cramorant.desc: A Beastie from a faraway land. It is known to be difficult to train as it uses the minimum amount of energy for its brainpower.
cramorant.name: Cramorant

daemon.desc: This Familiar's mind is mostly dedicated to mischief, but they seem to have taken a liking to Beastieball.
daemon.name: Daemon

despaireo.desc: In the rare circumstance that this lone spirit recieves enough negative energy, it embraces the despair of others nearby and channels it into power. This immense energy output requires a larger electrical device to contain it.
despaireo.name: Despaireo

fawnarch.desc: They have the ability to psychically induce fear in others, though they enjoy the company of other beasties too much to use it very often.
fawnarch.name: Fawnarch

gary.desc: This slimy Familiar cackles gleefully whenever they're splatted with a Beastieball, enjoying the mess that's been created.
gary.name: Gary

gloombox.desc: A lone spirit has possessed this electrical device, feeding off of the negative energy in its surrounding area. In most cases the energy received is not abundant enough to maintain the form, and will eventually collapse without it.
gloombox.name: Gloombox

hornet.desc: A strange creature with the regal bearing of a hunter. She appears to play for a test of skill, rather than a Beastie's instincts.
hornet.name: Hornet

mod_data.description: A reskin of Xiphosaur! Sometimes the colors can get a bit murky between flags...
mod_data.name: Pride Xiphosaur!

latias.desc: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

mod_data.author: howdy
mod_data.description: Adds Latias and Latios as beasties with custom art and signature moves.
mod_data.name: Eon Duo - Latias and Latios

latias.name: Latias

latios.desc: It has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head.

mod_data.author: howdy
mod_data.description: Adds Latias and Latios as beasties with custom art and signature moves.
mod_data.name: Eon Duo - Latias and Latios

latios.name: Latios

metta.desc: A primordial tyrant of.. something, or other. A beastie made of prismatic glass.
metta.name: Metta

nylandearie.desc: An artificially made Beastie, meant to be a pet for those who want a Beastie without the constant upkeep. Unfortunately, they've become an invasive species and threaten the local Calcroach and Debugly population.
nylandearie.name: Nylandearie

prints.desc: A field covered in this Familiar's spectral pawprints is the sign an intense game of Beastieball has just taken place.
prints.name: Prints

seeker.desc: A Familiar that loves to observe. They're anxious a Beastie may mistake it for a ball.
seeker.name: Seeker

sourbloom.desc: This skittish flower bud has a distinctly citrus aroma. They have been observed to occasionally show a mischievious side, swiping belongings with their long, extendable leaves.
sourbloom.name: Sourbloom

sparky.desc: These long, snakelike beasties may seem ferocious, but they are quite scared of people and other beasties. They rely on their wits more than their strength.
sparky.name: Sparky

tent.desc: A relaxed, amphibious Familiar that can often be seen retrieving lost balls from the water. They seem to get along well with Mudslee.
tent.name: Tent

topple.desc: A Plush-type Familiar that loves scavenging for lost buttons. They stumble into Beastieball games by accident.
topple.name: Topple

uppercrust.desc: Armed with a pair of stinging anenomes for boxing gloves, Uppercrust can adapt to different playstyles. Some have been seen cheering on allied Beasties, whereas others dominate the field with their powerful uppercuts.
uppercrust.name: Uppercrust
